paper_statement: Across the 150 (epsilon, delta) settings in Table 1, the best K in {1,...,20} (epsilon,delta)-DP multi-Gaussian has lower expected l1 loss than the analytic Gaussian in 142 settings; the all-setting improvement has mean 53.73%, sample standard deviation 34.86 percentage points, and median 61.86%.
baseline_verifier_scope: Checks the exact source table and its aggregate arithmetic. It is not independent scientific evidence and cannot verify Claim 1 by itself.
route_c_falsification_condition: For any epsilon>=2 table entry, reconstruct the largest sigma compatible with two-decimal rounding. FALSIFIED if an 80-decimal independent checker exhibits a shift in [0,1] and measurable interval S for which P(Z+shift in S)-exp(epsilon)P(Z in S)>delta by more than 1e-10, while calibrated analytic-Gaussian controls pass and 1%-reduced-scale controls fail.
pass_conditions: 142 positive entries when the eight paper NA cells are treated as no strict improvement
